title: Paperclip: an open-source orchestration platform for building zero-human companies

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: What if you could run an entire company with AI agents instead of employees? Paperclip is an open- source orchestration platform for building zero human companies. Through a gorgeous UI, you set up org charts, budgets, governance, and highle goals for your AI workforce. It's completely unopinionated about which agents you use, clawed code, openclaw bots. If it can receive a heartbeat signal, Paperclip considers it hired.
